$comment: Performance budgets of the 10,000-task account (OpenSpec change performance-10k). docs/performance.md shows the same table; `node --test scripts/perf/budgets.test.mjs` (make repo-check) fails when the two differ.

Settings: desktop and phone are measured nightly by scripts/perf/run.mjs (phone: 4x CPU throttling, 412x915), server by `go test -tags perf ./internal/perf`; a nightly run fails when the median of five runs exceeds the limit. device-android, device-ios and pi4 are recorded by hand before each minor release (scripts/perf/device.md) in docs/performance/results-<version>.md.
A limit is only raised in a pull request that states the reason, here and in its description.

Reviewed on 2026-11-03 against the first CI measurements (task 1.6; numbers in the pull requests and docs/performance.md). The interaction limits of the design (cursor 16 ms, completion and keystroke 50 ms on a computer; 50 and 150 in the phone profile) were set before the benchmark existed and are below what it can measure: it times from the input to the frame after the change (requestAnimationFrame, then a task), so an interaction that does nothing measures one frame of up to 16.7 ms plus the paint. They now follow the response times the design meant: on a computer the cursor in 50 ms (three frames: holding j keeps up with the key repeat) and a completion or keystroke in 100 ms (RAIL's instant response); in the phone profile, the CPU slowed four times as Lighthouse's mid-tier phone, 150 ms for the cursor and 200 ms for a completion or keystroke (Core Web Vitals' good interaction). The phones measured by hand keep their limits. No other limit changed.

notes-share raised from 100 to 130 MB on 2026-11-03 (OpenSpec change notes-compaction-at-scale, design D5): the first complete compaction of the notes fixture leaves 116 MB, all of it kept by the compaction rules: one revision per UTC day of each note's projection (13,400 descriptions, 65 MB), the 30-day window's documents (31 MB) and the current values, stored twice (the op and the materialized row, 15 MB). The 100 MB of performance-10k D7 was an estimate made before the fixture existed.
